rationales.generic_tool: Reusable source staging, package merge, toolchain preparation, progress recording or worked runtime example; retained rather than guessing that a supported command is obsolete.
rationales.local_package_test: Direct local src package import (including tests also importing scripts); kept with its complete local dependency closure.
rationales.original_tracked_script: One of the 57 protected scripts in sibling TRACKED_FILES.txt; retained byte-for-byte.
rationales.removed_orchestration_test: Only local script targets are retired cloud/run-specific orchestration; no direct local package import. Removed together with those targets, not on test-result grounds.
rationales.retained_script_or_helper_test: Tests retained scripts, or is an imported test helper; no failing test was hidden or disabled.
rationales.retained_test_fixture: Fixture for retained runtime-helper tests; preserve existing immutable expected inputs.
rationales.retired_test_fixture: Fixture used exclusively by retired continuous_agentic_pipeline tests.
rationales.runtime_helper_bundle: Runtime migration helpers and non-Python assets used by retained migration/preparation tools and package tests; directory retained conservatively as a complete bundle.
rationales.shared_template: Shared image/runtime/diagnostic template behavior and its direct tests retained conservatively.
rationales.transitive_dependency: Needed by retained local package tests, scripts or shared helpers; kept unchanged even when some inputs are historical.
rationales.untracked_cloud_orchestrator: Untracked Azure Batch deployment/campaign-specific orchestration outside the protected or retained dependency closure.
rationales.untracked_historical_orchestrator: Untracked historical native/continuous orchestration and versioned continuation chain, not a generic package API or retained dependency.
rationales.untracked_run_specific_tool: Untracked exact-run recovery, GPU/cloud handoff, source intake or operational adapter; not used by retained scripts or local package tests.

verification_records: Stored outside the repository in the publication transaction.
